_comment: M4 school social events (Kimi C). Gates ride the shared v3 path: in_circle school needs A's classmate circle; without classmates the family is silently skipped. All options free; outcomes M3c-audited.

events.title: The Lunch Table Question
events.text: The classroom has rearranged itself and {person:classmate} has waved me over to their lunch table.

choices.label: Sit with them
choices.outcome_text: I sat with my classmate at lunch and we traded snacks and terrible jokes until the bell.

choices.label: Sit on my own today
choices.outcome_text: I sat on my own at lunch with a book, peaceful enough, though the book was partly a shield.

events.title: Assigned Partners
events.text: The teacher has paired me with {person:classmate} for the group project, and we have wildly different ideas.

choices.label: Merge both ideas
choices.outcome_text: My classmate and I merged our two project ideas and the result was better than either of ours alone.

choices.label: Insist on my plan
choices.outcome_text: I talked my classmate into my project plan and we got a fine grade and a frosty silence.

events.title: The Rumour Mill
events.text: A ridiculous rumour about me is doing the rounds of the schoolyard, and {person:classmate} is repeating it.

choices.label: Laugh it off publicly
choices.outcome_text: I laughed at the silly rumour about me in front of everyone, and it died of starvation by Friday.

choices.label: Ask where they heard it
choices.outcome_text: I asked my classmate straight where the rumour came from; the trail went cold but so did they.

events.title: Picked (or Not)
events.text: Teams are being chosen in PE and the captains are weighing me and {person:classmate} for the last spot.

choices.label: Show some hustle
choices.outcome_text: I hustled hard in PE and got picked ahead of my classmate, then high-fived them on the way past.

choices.label: Let it happen
choices.outcome_text: I got picked last in PE and pretended not to care with the ancient dignity of the unchosen.

events.title: Can I Copy?
events.text: {person:classmate} wants to copy my homework ten minutes before it is due, and is doing the big pleading eyes.

choices.label: Refuse kindly
choices.outcome_text: I refused to let my classmate copy my homework, kindly, and offered to explain it after class instead.

choices.label: Slip them the pages
choices.outcome_text: I let my classmate copy my homework and we both got away with it, which is not the same as it being fine.

events.title: The Back Seat
events.text: There is exactly one good seat left on the school bus, and {person:classmate} and I have both spotted it.

choices.label: Share the seat
choices.outcome_text: My classmate and I squeezed into the good bus seat together and argued about window rights all the way home.

choices.label: Dive for it
choices.outcome_text: I dived into the last good bus seat ahead of my classmate and enjoyed it with a small side of guilt.

events.title: Show and Tell Panic
events.text: Show and tell is tomorrow and I have nothing, but {person:classmate} has offered to lend me their weird rock collection.

choices.label: Borrow the rocks
choices.outcome_text: I borrowed my classmate's weird rock collection for show and tell and it went disturbingly well.

choices.label: Present something of mine
choices.outcome_text: I did show and tell with a toy of my own and it was fine; the rocks remained a legend.

events.title: Study Group
events.text: {person:classmate} has invited me to their study group, which meets at the library and is apparently mostly snacks.

choices.label: Join the study group
choices.outcome_text: I joined my classmate's library study group and learned almost as much as I ate, which was a great deal.

choices.label: Study on my own
choices.outcome_text: I skipped the study group and studied solo in my room, efficient and slightly lonelier for it.
